A '''battle''' in [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] industrial area named [[The Works/Legends|The Works]]<ref name="DWD" /> took place in [[3629 BBY]],<ref name="Year" /> when [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kallin]] led his followers from the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] and planned to attack the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]] and frame the attack on the [[Eternal Alliance]]. The Alliance's [[Alliance Commander|leader]] intercepted Kullin on his way to the Senate building and defeated his forces.<ref name="DWD" />
